Select approved drugs with mechanism of action classified as an inhibitor. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno and to target_dictionary on tid. Filter for max_phase = 4 and action_type = 'INHIBITOR'. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name.
